description: Find South African statutes that implement or were influenced by a specific EU directive/regulation or international convention. Input the document ID (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR, "convention:budapest-cybercrime" for Budapest Convention). Returns matching SA statutes with alignment status.

in_force_only.description: Return only statutes currently in force (default: false)

primary_only.description: Return only primary implementing/aligned statutes (default: false)

name: get_southafrican_implementations
